455741.overview: Othello is a computer adaptation of the classic board game. The game can be played with another player, or against the computer. The computer has two difficulty levels. Players take turn placing tokens of their color on a grid. Whenever a token is placed any enclosed tokens of the other player flip color. Enclosing can happen horizontally, vertically and diagonally. Whoever has the most tokens on the board when the board is filled wins the game.
